acceptance_predicates.description: A selection-driven TUI journey accepts dev or an explicit channel, configures provider/model and agents, runs workloads, records, replays offline, compares, and analyzes.
The receipt includes exact ASB/TUI heads, channel, source/build identity, and network-denial evidence.
Generated development credentials and signatures are warnings only.

definition_of_done: Channel-aware quickstart and release gate pass at exact paired heads.
Independent review confirms interactive claims use a PTY.

inputs.description: Exact product heads and disposable workspace.
